To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
• A UML 2.x profile is proposed to describe embedded systems.

we present an approach for the model-based development of real-time embedded systems using UML and that this approach is based on the integration of UML state and sequence diagrams and the execution of the models using a UML virtual Machine.
we have presented an approach for model based design of embedded systems, based on the development and execution of UML 2 models on a UVM, and that we have implemented a prototype for this approach.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following topics: • Model-based design of embedded real-time systems. • Formal specification of embedded real-time software systems.

the following questions: How can we develop embedded systems using model-based techniques and UML? Which UML features are necessary for the development of embedded systems? How can we execute such models directly on a UML Virtual Machine? What is the impact of the model-based approach on the design process?
the design of an object-oriented modeling language and its implementation on a virtual machine, which is suitable for the development of embedded software.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the UML 2 is a powerful tool for the development of embedded systems.
the approach is very promising and that the results are convincing.

the UML 2.x specification is a very good starting point for the development of an object-oriented, executable modeling language for embedded systems, which has the potential to replace the current de-facto standard for embedded system development, C.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we provide a complete model-based development process for embedded systems.
we are able to model and execute embedded systems using UML.
we provide a complete and precise UML subset with precise execution and semantics.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a UML subset can be designed that allows for a direct implementation of the system specification.
UML 2 can be applied to model and execute embedded systems in a very natural way.
UML is a powerful modeling language that can be used for model-driven development of embedded systems.
